name: re_exec_all
title: Extract data from all regular expression matches

origin.description: Returns every match with positions. A string with no match contributes empty vectors.
origin.details: Returns every match with positions. A string with no match contributes empty vectors.
origin.value: re_exec_all of "  Ben Franklin and Jefferson Davis" returns Ben at 3 through 5 and Jefferson at 20 through 28.
origin.example:
allpos <- re_exec_all("  Ben Franklin and Jefferson Davis", "(?<first>[[:upper:]][[:lower:]]+) (?<last>[[:upper:]][[:lower:]]+)")
allpos$first$match
